title: A shelter kept secret
body: The shelter key is packed with a note promising it will stay hidden; the entry sheet says the gate was opened for a scheduled pickup that never arrived.
rival_reading: A field crew could use a private shelter and schedule a supply run; the missed pickup does not identify who ordered it.
gloss: A hidden shelter is opened for a pickup that does not arrive.

cites.quote: They'll never find us here, trust me
